sources.title: Termany README
sources.locator: Sections: Many sessions; Bots; Review; Worktrees and remote hosts; Agent cost; Install; Configuration; How it is built; Roadmap
sources.finding: Terminal for many agent sessions with ACTIVE state tags, Bots and group chat with a lead, file/diff/browser pane views, per-pane SSH, usage dashboard, BYOK providers, loopback-only server, AGPL-3.0; roadmap lists reconnect, LocalPtyBackend and cloud as future.

sources.title: Termany LICENSE
sources.finding: AGPL-3.0 with a notice that a separate commercial licence is available from ThinkAny, LLC by contact.

sources.title: Root package.json
sources.finding: license "AGPL-3.0-only"; npm workspaces apps/* and packages/*; scripts dev:web, dev:desktop, bundle:server; no bin entry.

sources.title: Tauri config
sources.finding: Tauri 2 desktop shell, 1280x832 window, updater endpoint https://cdn.termany.sh/latest.json, bundle targets app and dmg.

sources.title: Build and Release workflow
sources.finding: Matrix macos-arm64/x64 (signed, notarized), windows-x64 (NSIS, unsigned) and linux-x64 (AppImage/deb, manual test build until its next public release).

sources.title: Built-in agent registry
sources.finding: Built-in agents claude, codex, openclaw (enabled) and gemini, grok, fastclaw, hermes, opencode, cursor (cursor-agent), kimi, omp (disabled by default); custom agents can be added with a command and args or an ACP HTTP endpoint.

sources.title: Managed ACP bridges
sources.finding: Ships @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp and codex-acp bridges that drive the user-installed claude/codex CLI.

sources.title: Subscription-preserving credentials
sources.finding: Strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY style variables from Bot conversations so Claude and Codex stay on the CLI login (subscription); terminal panes keep the user shell environment.

sources.title: BYOK provider config
sources.finding: Providers are user-added Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible endpoints with the user own key stored in local SQLite; no built-in managed provider.

sources.title: Local model gateway
sources.finding: Local gateway at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/gateway lets agent CLIs use a configured BYOK provider through protocol translation; routes use per-route bearer tokens.

sources.title: Request guard
sources.finding: Server binds 127.0.0.1 by default, rejects unknown Origin and non-loopback Host; TERMANY_HOST can expose it with no authentication (README warning).

sources.title: Server HTTP and WebSocket routes
sources.finding: REST routes for state, activity, agents, ACP chat/permission, SSH, fs, git, usage, system stats; detached PTYs kept for 7 days (TERMANY_DETACH_TTL_MS); no issue, schedule or user-account routes.

sources.title: Local SQLite store
sources.finding: Single ~/.termany/termany.db with workspace, app_meta, session_cwd, session_scroll, session_screen tables; scroll history capped at 40 sessions.

sources.title: Agent activity tracker
sources.finding: Server-owned working/done/needs-attention state derived from foreground job and screen content; epoch-checked report and ack routes; SSE snapshots.

sources.title: Git overview and diffs
sources.finding: Read-only git calls: rev-parse, worktree list, status, diff, merge-base; no commit, push, branch creation, worktree add or PR operations.

sources.title: Agent session history readers
sources.finding: Reads Claude (~/.claude/projects) and Codex (~/.codex/sessions) transcripts for history and token usage; other agents unsupported.

sources.title: SSH profiles and tests
sources.finding: Per-pane SSH profiles (host, user, port, password or identity file) with connection test; runs through local OpenSSH.

sources.title: SSH port forwarding
sources.finding: One-click loopback SSH forward for ports served on a remote pane.

sources.title: Agent usage dashboard
sources.finding: Estimated dollar cost from a built-in $/MTok price table over transcript tokens; unpriced models counted as unpriced tokens.

sources.title: Group chat and lead dispatch
sources.finding: Group chats of Bots: a lead member is asked for a JSON dispatch decision (none, single, parallel, sequential), members reply in separate sessions, @ mentions route, max 24 turns, 90 s member inactivity timeout.

sources.title: Group decision failover
sources.finding: 30 s decision timeout with up to 3 attempts and failover to another member as leader.

sources.title: Skill discovery and Bot binding
sources.finding: Discovers ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude/skills and Codex skills; GitHub import into ~/.termany/skills; prompts carry skill names and absolute SKILL.md paths.

sources.title: termany.sh home page
sources.locator: Hero, Overview, Collab, Active, Review, Remote, Usage, Themes, footer
sources.finding: Site states local-first open-source desktop terminal, Download v0.2.5 for macOS, Windows, Linux, AGPL-3.0; sections for Bots, review, worktrees, usage; no pricing page.

sources.title: termany.sh llms.txt
sources.finding: Site summary says installers for macOS, Windows and Linux; states termany.sh is not a remote MCP server; lists current release 0.2.5 (stale against the 0.2.8 GitHub release).

sources.title: termany.sh Privacy Policy
sources.finding: Generic website privacy policy (account info, usage data, cookies, payment info) last updated 2026-07-01; does not describe the desktop app data flows, telemetry, retention or training use.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: Report privately to support@thinkany.ai; keys stored locally and sent only to the configured provider; local server bound to localhost, unauthenticated-access reports in scope.
